name: The Weeping Guardian
description: A stone colossus from the Aurelian age stands dormant in the village ruins. It has begun to leak wild mana, poisoning the local wells.
objectives: Locate the Weeping Guardian in the Shattered Plaza
Find a way to soothe or dismantle the Guardian
narrative_guidelines: The Guardian is a relic of the old world, made of white marble and gold. It 'weeps' liquid mana from its eye-sockets. It is not inherently evil, but malfunctioning. Mention how the player's blood feels warm and begins to hum as they approach the colossus.
